questions.question: Consider two independent random variables X and Y with identical distributions. The variables X and Y take values 0, 1 and 2 with probabilities [latex]\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{4}\;  and \; \frac{1}{4}[/latex] respectively. What is the conditional probability P(X+Y=2|X-Y=0)?
questions.explanation: [latex]\begin{array}{c} P(A \mid B)=\frac{P(A \cap B)}{P(B)} \\ P(X+Y=2 \mid X-Y=0) \\ =\frac{P(X+Y=2, X-Y=0)}{P(X-Y=0)} \\ P(X-Y=0)=P(X=0, Y=0)\\ +P(X=1, Y=1)+P(X=2, Y=2) \\ =P(X=0) \cdot P(Y=0)+P(X=1) \cdot P(Y=1) \\ +P(X=2) \cdot P(Y=2) \\ =\frac{3}{8} \\ P(X+Y=2, X-Y=0)=P(X=1, Y=1) \\ =P(X=1) \cdot P(Y=1) \\ =\frac{1}{16} \\ \therefore \quad P(X+Y=2 \mid X-Y=0)=-\frac{1}{16} \times \frac{8}{3}=\frac{1}{6} \end{array}[/latex]

questions.question: Consider two independent random variables X and Y with identical distributions. The variables X and Y take values 0, 1 and 2 with probabilities [latex]\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{4}\;  and \; \frac{1}{4}[/latex] respectively. What is the conditional probability P(X+Y=2|X-Y=0)?
questions.explanation: [latex]\begin{array}{c} P(A \mid B)=\frac{P(A \cap B)}{P(B)} \\ P(X+Y=2 \mid X-Y=0) \\ =\frac{P(X+Y=2, X-Y=0)}{P(X-Y=0)} \\ P(X-Y=0)=P(X=0, Y=0)\\ +P(X=1, Y=1)+P(X=2, Y=2) \\ =P(X=0) \cdot P(Y=0)+P(X=1) \cdot P(Y=1) \\ +P(X=2) \cdot P(Y=2) \\ =\frac{3}{8} \\ P(X+Y=2, X-Y=0)=P(X=1, Y=1) \\ =P(X=1) \cdot P(Y=1) \\ =\frac{1}{16} \\ \therefore \quad P(X+Y=2 \mid X-Y=0)=-\frac{1}{16} \times \frac{8}{3}=\frac{1}{6} \end{array}[/latex]
questions.explanation_html: [latex]\begin{array}{c} P(A \mid B)=\frac{P(A \cap B)}{P(B)} \\ P(X+Y=2 \mid X-Y=0) \\ =\frac{P(X+Y=2, X-Y=0)}{P(X-Y=0)} \\ P(X-Y=0)=P(X=0, Y=0)\\ +P(X=1, Y=1)+P(X=2, Y=2) \\ =P(X=0) \cdot P(Y=0)+P(X=1) \cdot P(Y=1) \\ +P(X=2) \cdot P(Y=2) \\ =\frac{3}{8} \\ P(X+Y=2, X-Y=0)=P(X=1, Y=1) \\ =P(X=1) \cdot P(Y=1) \\ =\frac{1}{16} \\ \therefore \quad P(X+Y=2 \mid X-Y=0)=-\frac{1}{16} \times \frac{8}{3}=\frac{1}{6} \end{array}[/latex]

If only P1 is pressed, '2' is displayed, signifying 'Rs. 2' If only P2 is pressed '5' is displayed, signifying 'Rs. 5' If both P1 and P2 are pressed, ' ' E is displayed, signifying 'Error' The names of the segments in the 7-segment display, and the glow of the display for '0', '2', '5' and 'E' are shown below. Consider (1) push buttons pressed/not pressed in equivalent to logic 1/0 respectively. (2) a segment glowing/not glowing in the display is equivalent to logic 1/0
respectively. What are the minimum numbers of NOT gates and 2-input OR gates required
to design the logic of the driver for this 7-Segment display
questions.explanation: 2 NOT gates 3 OR gates
